hypothesis: A bounded 4 cm lateral lead toward the ball's off-center side reduces measured ball-minus-foot y at impact and therefore lateral ball drift; both outcomes must be measured, not inferred from target commands.
shared_setup: Frozen SONIC, actor, asset, parent, course, acquisition gap 0.95 m, lateral cap 0.15 m, forward cap 0.08 m, revalidation true, independent physics process per arm
required_audits: Independent first contact, per-frame action replay, same source/asset/actor/parent/course, measured ball-minus-contacting-foot y at first contact
development_gate: No loss of foot-only contact or pelvis below 0.65 m, fewer total >4 m out-of-play courses, at least four of seven courses reduce absolute contact lateral bias and absolute 60-frame lateral displacement. Otherwise reject. No policy promotion even if passed without fresh holdout.
